title: SCS Deep Dive: Software Supply Chain Intelligence 360
subtitle: Everything Software Supply Chain Security in one place: artifact inventory, SBOM quality and component risk (EOL, deprecated, vulnerable, licences), STO vulnerability exposure per artifact, CI/CD pipeline compliance (OWASP), signing and SLSA provenance attestation, OPA policy-as-code outcomes and SCS adoption, with cross-entity correlations and drill-through to Harness SCS.

widget.text: # SCS Deep Dive: Software Supply Chain Intelligence 360

**What's inside:** one KPI strip, then eight tabs (Executive Posture, Artifacts, SBOM & Components, Vulnerabilities, Compliance, Attestation & Provenance, Policy as Code, Activity & Adoption) built on every SCS entity (`ssca:artifact`, `sbom_component` joined to the 990k-row `component_metadata` catalogue, `compliance_result`, `provenance`, `artifact_activity`, `artifact_source`), the SCS summary views and OPA policy evaluations, correlated with pipeline executions and STO scans.  
**How to use:** the date picker drives every widget (default: last 2 years, because CI/CD compliance results stop in Oct 2025). Organization / Project / Artifact Type / Artifact Name narrow artifact-centric widgets; Severity, Compliance Category and Scan Type narrow compliance widgets; Activity Type narrows activity widgets. Blue links open the artifact URL, the SCS artifacts page, the pipeline or the execution in Harness. AI-BOM counts are zero in this account, so there is no AI-BOM tab.

widget.text: ### Coverage funnel and posture by project

widget.title: Supply Chain Control Coverage by Artifact Type

queries.query:
find entity "ssca:artifact" a
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h on h.account_identifier = a.account_identifier
| filter array_contains(a.scopes, concat('{"org_identifier":"', h.org_identifier, '","project_identifier":"', h.project_identifier, '","parent_unique_id":"', h.parent_unique_id, '"}'))
| filter a.last_activity_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.last_activity_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${atype_filter_predicate} and ${aname_filter_predicate}
| select {
a.type as artifact_type,
count() as artifacts,
sum(case when a.sbom_component_count > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as with_sbom,
sum(case when a.sto_total_vulnerabilities > 0 or a.sto_pipeline_execution_id != "" then 1 else 0 end) as vuln_scanned,
sum(case when a.signing_verification_status != "" then 1 else 0 end) as signed,
sum(case when a.provenance_status != "" then 1 else 0 end) as with_provenance,
sum(case when a.compliance_check_passed + a.compliance_check_failed > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as compliance_evaluated
}
| group_by artifact_type
| order_by artifacts desc

widget.subtitle: Grouped columns: how many artifacts of each type have each supply-chain control applied

widget.title: Project Supply Chain Scorecard

queries.query:
find entity "ssca:artifact" a
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h on h.account_identifier = a.account_identifier
| filter array_contains(a.scopes, concat('{"org_identifier":"', h.org_identifier, '","project_identifier":"', h.project_identifier, '","parent_unique_id":"', h.parent_unique_id, '"}'))
| filter a.last_activity_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.last_activity_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${atype_filter_predicate} and ${aname_filter_predicate}
| select {
h.org_identifier as org,
h.project_identifier as project,
count() as artifacts,
round(sum(case when a.sbom_component_count > 0 then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0
/ (case when sum(case when a.type != "WORKFLOW" then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then sum(case when a.type != "WORKFLOW" then 1 else 0 end) else 1 end), 1) as sbom_coverage_pct,
sum(case when a.signing_verification_status != "" then 1 else 0 end) as signed,
sum(case when a.provenance_status != "" then 1 else 0 end) as provenance,
sum(a.sto_critical) as critical,
sum(a.sto_high) as high,
sum(a.compliance_check_failed) as compliance_failed,
max(a.last_activity_at) as last_activity
}
| group_by org, project
| order_by artifacts desc

widget.title: Artifact Inventory (drill-through)

queries.query:
find entity "ssca:artifact" a
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h on h.account_identifier = a.account_identifier
| filter array_contains(a.scopes, concat('{"org_identifier":"', h.org_identifier, '","project_identifier":"', h.project_identifier, '","parent_unique_id":"', h.parent_unique_id, '"}'))
| filter a.last_activity_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.last_activity_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${atype_filter_predicate} and ${aname_filter_predicate}
| select {
a.name as artifact,
a.tag as tag,
a.type as artifact_type,
h.org_identifier as org,
h.project_identifier as project,
a.url as registry_url,
a.sbom_format as sbom_format,
a.sbom_component_count as components,
round(cast(case when a.sbom_avg_score = "" then "0" else a.sbom_avg_score end as double), 1) as sbom_score,
a.sbom_component_count > 0 as has_sbom,
case when a.signing_verification_status = "" then "Not signed" else a.signing_verification_status end as signing,
case when a.provenance_status = "" then "No provenance" else a.provenance_status end as provenance,
a.sto_critical as critical,
a.sto_high as high,
a.sto_total_vulnerabilities as total_vulns,
a.prod_env_count as prod_envs,
a.non_prod_env_count as non_prod_envs,
a.digest as digest,
a.last_activity_at as last_activity,
"Open in SCS" as scs
}
| order_by total_vulns desc, last_activity desc
| limit 300

widget.title: Component Risk by Ecosystem

queries.query:
find entity "ssca:sbom_component" sc
| join entity "ssca:artifact" a on a.uuid = sc.artifact_v2_id
| join entity "ssca:component_metadata" cm on cm.purl = sc.purl
| filter sc.created_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and sc.created_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${atype_filter_predicate} and ${aname_filter_predicate}
| select {
cm.ecosystem as ecosystem,
sum(case when cm.vuln_total_count > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as vulnerable,
sum(case when cm.is_eol then 1 else 0 end) as eol,
sum(case when cm.is_deprecated then 1 else 0 end) as deprecated,
sum(case when cm.is_malicious or cm.squatted_package != "" then 1 else 0 end) as malicious_or_squatted
}
| group_by ecosystem
| order_by vulnerable desc

find entity "ssca:sbom_component" sc

}

| order_by artifacts desc
| limit 100

queries.query:
with v as (find entity "ssca:sbom_component" sc
| join entity "ssca:artifact" a on a.uuid = sc.artifact_v2_id
| join entity "ssca:component_metadata" cm on cm.purl = sc.purl
| filter sc.created_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and sc.created_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${atype_filter_predicate} and ${aname_filter_predicate}
and cm.vuln_total_count > 0
| select {
sc.package_name as package,
cm.version as version,
max(cm.vuln_critical_count) as critical,
max(cm.vuln_high_count) as high,
max(cm.vuln_medium_count) as medium,
max(cm.vuln_low_count) as low,
distinct_count(sc.artifact_v2_id) as artifacts
}
| group_by package, version)
find v
| select {
package, version, critical, high, medium, low, artifacts,
round((critical * 10 + high * 5 + medium * 2 + low) * artifacts * 100.0
/ sum((critical * 10 + high * 5 + medium * 2 + low) * artifacts) over (), 1) as share_of_risk_pct
}
| order_by share_of_risk_pct desc
| limit 100

widget.title: Severity Mix

queries.query:
with tot as (find entity "ssca:artifact" a
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h on h.account_identifier = a.account_identifier
| filter array_contains(a.scopes, concat('{"org_identifier":"', h.org_identifier, '","project_identifier":"', h.project_identifier, '","parent_unique_id":"', h.parent_unique_id, '"}'))
| filter a.last_activity_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.last_activity_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${atype_filter_predicate} and ${aname_filter_predicate}
| select { 1 as j, sum(a.sto_critical) as c, sum(a.sto_high) as hi, sum(a.sto_medium) as m, sum(a.sto_low) as l,
sum(a.sto_info) as i }),
k as (find view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" x | select { 1 as j, row_number() over (order by x.parent_unique_id) as r })
find k
| join tot on tot.j = k.j
| filter k.r <= 5
| select {
case when k.r = 1 then "Critical" when k.r = 2 then "High" when k.r = 3 then "Medium"
when k.r = 4 then "Low" else "Info" end as severity,
case when k.r = 1 then tot.c when k.r = 2 then tot.hi when k.r = 3 then tot.m
when k.r = 4 then tot.l else tot.i end as findings
}

queries.query:
with r as (find entity "ssca:artifact" a
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h on h.account_identifier = a.account_identifier
| filter array_contains(a.scopes, concat('{"org_identifier":"', h.org_identifier, '","project_identifier":"', h.project_identifier, '","parent_unique_id":"', h.parent_unique_id, '"}'))
| filter a.last_activity_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.last_activity_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${atype_filter_predicate} and ${aname_filter_predicate}
and a.sto_total_vulnerabilities > 0
| select {
h.org_identifier as org,
h.project_identifier as project,
a.name as artifact,
a.tag as tag,
a.url as registry_url,

a.sto_critical as critical,
a.sto_high as high,
a.sto_medium as medium,
a.sto_low as low,
a.sto_ignored as ignored,
a.sbom_component_count as components,
a.sto_critical * 10 + a.sto_high * 5 + a.sto_medium * 2 + a.sto_low as risk_score
})
find r
| select {
org, project, artifact, tag, registry_url, scanner, critical, high, medium, low, ignored, components, risk_score,
round(risk_score * 100.0 / sum(risk_score) over (), 1) as share_of_risk_pct,
round(risk_score * 1000.0 / (case when components > 0 then components else 1 end), 1) as risk_per_1k_components,
"Open in SCS" as scs
}
| order_by risk_score desc
| limit 100

queries.query:
with r as (find entity "ssca:artifact" a
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h on h.account_identifier = a.account_identifier
| filter array_contains(a.scopes, concat('{"org_identifier":"', h.org_identifier, '","project_identifier":"', h.project_identifier, '","parent_unique_id":"', h.parent_unique_id, '"}'))
| filter a.last_activity_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.last_activity_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${atype_filter_predicate} and ${aname_filter_predicate}
| select {
a.name as artifact,
a.tag as tag,
h.project_identifier as project,
a.sto_critical * 10 + a.sto_high * 5 + a.sto_medium * 2 + a.sto_low as risk_score,
a.sto_total_vulnerabilities as total_vulns
}),
s as (find r | select { artifact, tag, project, risk_score, total_vulns, avg(risk_score) over () as avg_risk })
find s
| filter risk_score > 2 * avg_risk
| select { artifact, tag, project, risk_score, total_vulns, round(avg_risk, 1) as avg_risk,
round(risk_score / avg_risk, 1) as x_times_avg }
| order_by risk_score desc
| limit 50

| left join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h on h.parent_unique_id = t.parent_unique_id
| filter t.evaluation_date >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and t.evaluation_date <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${scantype_filter_predicate}
| select {
date_trunc("week", t.evaluation_date) as week,
sum(t.rules_passed) as rules_passed,
sum(t.rules_failed) as rules_failed,
round(sum(t.rules_failed) * 100.0 / (case when sum(t.rules_passed) + sum(t.rules_failed) > 0 then sum(t.rules_passed) + sum(t.rules_failed) else 1 end), 1) as fail_rate_pct
}
| group_by week
| order_by week

queries.query:
find entity "ssca:compliance_result" c
| join entity "ssca:artifact" a on a.uuid = c.artifact_id
| filter c.created_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and c.created_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${atype_filter_predicate} and ${aname_filter_predicate}
and ${sev_filter_predicate} and ${ccat_filter_predicate} and ${scantype_filter_predicate}
| select {
c.compliance_id as rule_id,
c.title as rule,
c.category as category,
c.severity as severity,
sum(case when c.status = "FAILED" then 1 else 0 end) as failures,
count() as evaluations,
round(sum(case when c.status = "FAILED" then 1 else 0 end) * 100.0 / count(), 1) as fail_rate_pct,
distinct_count(case when c.status = "FAILED" then c.source_name end) as pipelines_failing,
max(c.remediation) as remediation
}
| group_by rule_id, rule, category, severity

queries.query:
with latest as (find entity "ssca:compliance_result" c
| join entity "ssca:artifact" a on a.uuid = c.artifact_id
| filter c.created_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and c.created_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${atype_filter_predicate} and ${aname_filter_predicate}
and ${sev_filter_predicate} and ${ccat_filter_predicate} and ${scantype_filter_predicate}
| select {
c.org_identifier as org,
c.project_identifier as project,
c.source_name as source_name,
c.pipeline_identifier as pipeline,
c.url as url,
c.compliance_id as compliance_id,
c.severity as severity,
c.status as status,
c.created_at as evaluated_at,
row_number() over (partition by c.source_name, c.compliance_id order by c.created_at desc) as rn
})
find latest
| filter rn = 1 and status = "FAILED"
| select {
org, project, source_name, pipeline, url,
count() as failing_rules,
count(case when severity = "CRITICAL" then compliance_id end) as critical_failures,
count(case when severity = "HIGH" then compliance_id end) as high_failures,
count(case when severity = "MEDIUM" then compliance_id end) as medium_failures,
max(evaluated_at) as last_evaluated
}
| group_by org, project, source_name, pipeline, url
| order_by critical_failures desc, high_failures desc, failing_rules desc

queries.query:
find entity "ssca:artifact" a
| join view "view:sto:hierarchy_lookup" h on h.account_identifier = a.account_identifier
| filter array_contains(a.scopes, concat('{"org_identifier":"', h.org_identifier, '","project_identifier":"', h.project_identifier, '","parent_unique_id":"', h.parent_unique_id, '"}'))
| filter a.last_activity_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.last_activity_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp)
and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate}
and ${atype_filter_predicate} and ${aname_filter_predicate}
and a.type = "CONTAINER"
| select {
a.name as artifact,
a.tag as tag,
h.org_identifier as org,
h.project_identifier as project,
case when a.signing_verification_status = "" then "Not signed" else a.signing_verification_status end as signing,
case when a.provenance_status = "" then "No provenance" else a.provenance_status end as provenance,
a.sbom_component_count > 0 as has_sbom,
a.sbom_format as sbom_format,
case when a.signing_verification_status = "" then "Unsigned"
when a.provenance_status = "passed" then "Signed + provenance verified"
else "Signed, no verified provenance" end as slsa_posture,
a.sto_critical as critical,
a.last_activity_at as last_activity,
"Open in SCS" as scs
}
| order_by signing desc, provenance desc
| limit 200

widget.subtitle: Per container image: signature, provenance, SBOM and a derived SLSA-style posture label
